summary.text: Joan Lovely is a Democratic state senator representing the 2nd Essex District, in office since January 2013, and is on the November 3, 2026 general election ballot seeking re-election.
Ballotpedia lists her profession as attorney and realtor and notes prior service on the Salem City Council from 1998 to 2013.

paragraphs.text: Joan Lovely's education, according to Ballotpedia, includes Beverly High School, a bachelor's degree from Salem State University, and a law degree from the Massachusetts School of Law.
She served on the Salem City Council from 1998 to 2013 and assumed office in the State Senate on January 2, 2013.
She advanced from the Democratic primary on September 1, 2026.
